req.title: Content-Type is JSON
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /players endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-026 mandates that every /players/* endpoint returning a body must set Content-Type: application/json. We must verify this for all body-returning endpoints (GET /players/, GET /players/{id}, GET /players/squadnumber/{n}, POST /players/) and confirm that no-body endpoints (PUT 204, DELETE 204) are excluded from the requirement. Tests cover: positive EP for each body-returning endpoint, negative path for 4xx error responses (which still return a JSON body), and boundary cases around the exact content-type string value. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact header string 'application/json', exact status codes, and testing both sides of the body/no-body distinction.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_plain
actions: Assert Content-Type is exactly 'application/json' (with optional charset)
Assert Content-Type is NOT 'text/html' and NOT 'text/plain'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_plain():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    assert not ct.startswith('text/html')
    assert not ct.startswith('text/plain')
    assert not ct.startswith('application/xml')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    assert 'text/html' not in ct

tests.name: test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_json_content_type
preconditions: All GET endpoints and POST endpoint are available
actions: Send GET /players/{uuid} for squad 5 and check Content-Type
Send POST /players/ with new squad_number=98 and check Content-Type
expected: All responses have Content-Type starting with 'application/json'
All response bodies are valid JSON
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_json_content_type():
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r1.headers.get('content-type', '').startswith('application/json')
    assert isinstance(r1.json(), list)

    r2 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/5')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.headers.get('content-type', '').startswith('application/json')
    assert r2.json()['squadNumber'] == 5

    uuid_5 = '2b515093-76be-4c72-98de-729c368f7ddb'
    r3 = client.get(f'/players/{uuid_5}')
    assert r3.status_code == 200
    assert r3.headers.get('content-type', '').startswith('application/json')
    assert r3.json()['id'] == uuid_5

    payload = {'firstName': 'New', 'lastName': 'Guy', 'squadNumber': 98, 'position': 'Left-Back'}
    r4 = client.post('/players/', json=payload)
    assert r4.status_code == 201
    assert r4.headers.get('content-type', '').startswith('application/json')
    assert r4.json()['squadNumber'] == 98
